# Eduard Toader — Executive Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Eduard Toader, a senior development professional with 30+ years of experience across real estate and renewable energy in Romania.

## What this site offers
- Professional background and an experience timeline: Qair Renewables Romania, Amromco Energy, WPD Romania, Kaufland Romania, and earlier network-development roles (Shell, Amoco, Connex/Vodafone, Billa, Plus Discount, Trigranit, GFS)
- Core competencies: land acquisition for wind, solar and BESS projects; permitting and regulatory affairs; commercial real estate development; stakeholder and authority relations; contract negotiation
- Bilingual content in English and Romanian
- A contact form for project, partnership and investment inquiries

## Key achievements highlighted
- 248 ha of solar and BESS parks secured (Prahova and Mehedinți counties, Romania)
- 6+ BESS plots secured, plus land agreement for a 40MW wind park
